ShortDescription.Value: Cities: Skylines 2 Multiplayer mod, build one shared city with a friend

Publish.LongDescription:
Play Cities: Skylines II together.
CS2 Multiplayer is a client-server multiplayer mod that allows multiple players to build and manage the same city in real time. **Mods currently do not work in Multiplayer!** The mod is currently experimental. Please back up your saves and expect bugs, missing features or crashes while development continues. To host a game, start a multiplayer world, optionally protect it with a password, and share your IP address with your friends or share ur steamcode. If you encounter any issues or have feedback, our Discord server ( https://discord.gg/KFZTW2YSJt ) is the preferred place to get support and report bugs. This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Colossal Order, Paradox Interactive, or Iceflake Studio.
